full_suite_reconciliation_20260820.reason: bind the exact approved convergence checkpoint implementation and dependency manifest required by the canonical full-suite publish gate

baseline_approval_contract.admission: The approval record must exist in the state, match exactly, and remain applicable to the prepared state hash. Contract approval is not baseline acceptance approval.
baseline_approval_contract.helper_receipt: accept-baseline and guard-baseline must emit structured receipts containing approval id, prior/new state hashes, accepted path hashes, stage, outer iteration, verdict, and helper hash.

child_execution_contract.admission: child_owner_sequence_id resolves to the exact content-addressed executable contract; child parameters validate; its complete UnitBudget is reserved; guard_receipt_id binds the same contract/parameters/source; and the child has an implemented STARTED reconciler and semantic terminal verifier.
child_execution_contract.dispatch: After the baseline lock is released, prepare and execute the typed child through prevention owner dispatch; never invoke subprocess.run on caller argv.
child_execution_contract.rejection: A raw argv array, shell command, exit-zero-only child, stale guard receipt, or incomplete child contract rejects before baseline acceptance or lock acquisition.

baseline_reconciliation.ALREADY_APPLIED: The state contains exactly one matching structured accept-baseline receipt and a passing guard receipt for the prepared approval, stage, outer iteration, repository, ledger/view hashes, and helper hash.
baseline_reconciliation.INDETERMINATE: State, approval, unrelated baseline paths, helper, ledger/view identity, acceptance receipt, or guard receipt conflicts with preparation.
baseline_reconciliation.NOT_APPLIED: The prepared state and baseline hashes remain unchanged and no matching acceptance receipt exists.

effect_and_reconciliation_contract.child_reconciliation: Delegate to the exact child owner reconciler using child effect id. A semantic child terminal artifact is ALREADY_APPLIED; no prepared child effect after a valid checkpoint is NOT_APPLIED; child identity disagreement or INDETERMINATE result stops the parent.
effect_and_reconciliation_contract.effect_identity: prepared convergence state hash plus approval id/scope plus repository/helper hashes plus canonical ledger/view pre-hashes plus child owner/contract/intent/guard identities
effect_and_reconciliation_contract.prepare: Persist the full identity, expected baseline transition, fixed lock target, child effect id, complete composed UnitBudget, and initially observed state/ledger/view hashes before baseline acceptance.
effect_and_reconciliation_contract.resume_rule: If baseline acceptance is already applied, do not accept it again; resume only the child. If the child is already applied, do not execute it again. Lock timeout remains a non-applied failure and never broadens accepted drift.

stage.derived_from: the exact approval scope in state at the current outer_iteration

parameter_contract.validation_boundary: Before budget reservation, validate state schema/hash, fixed repository/helper/ledger/view identities, helper hash, approval scope and current outer iteration, typed child intent/contract/parameters, child guard receipt, and complete child UnitBudget. Reject arbitrary argv, helper, repo, stage, lock timeout, or paths outside trusted roots.

common: The checkpoint owner process return code is zero.
Structured accept-baseline and guard-baseline receipts semantically match preparation.
The exact typed child has one successful semantic terminal artifact; child exit zero or the legacy pass string alone is insufficient.
Exactly one checkpoint owner_terminal event and matching terminal artifact exist for parent effect_id.
source_corrections: Fix repository, helper, ledger/view, stage, and lock-timeout authority instead of accepting caller paths and values.
Replace schema-v1 arbitrary argv command JSON with a typed content-addressed child intent and exact guard receipt.
Compose the complete child UnitBudget with the parent's eight-hour budget before accepting the baseline.
Persist structured helper receipts and reconcile baseline acceptance after crashes instead of rerunning accept/guard blindly.
Terminalize only from the child's semantic terminal artifact and exactly one parent terminal event, not the fixed pass string.
Use the current accept-baseline generated-overlap flag so the checkpoint controller and authoritative convergence helper share one executable CLI contract.
terminal_contract.success: The terminal artifact names state/approval/stage/outer-iteration hashes, helper and repository identities, accepted ledger/view baseline hashes, guard verdict, child owner/contract/intent/effect ids, child UnitBudget hash, child terminal artifact hash, and parent verdict. Any unrelated baseline drift, stale approval/guard, or child semantic failure prevents success.

unit_budget.reservation_rule: Reserve the complete eight-hour parent budget and the complete child UnitBudget before baseline acceptance. The child retains its own sixty-minute atomic-task caps and progressive reservation rules; callers cannot supply either budget.

variables.CHILD_DURATION_MILLISECONDS: The exact complete UnitBudget duration loaded from the content-addressed executable child owner contract after child parameters are materialized.
